memory_update.text: FTDR should be tracked as a direct home-warranty and repair-dispatch rail, not merely a consumer warranty stock.
APPF maps to rental-operations workflow rails; key survival tests are units under management, value-added-services attach, and transaction monetization.
STC is an underfollowed title/escrow transaction-rail candidate with cyclical housing-turnover exposure and regulated workflow characteristics.
BXC is a speculative-shadow candidate for repair/remodel distribution; evidence must separate durable repair/remodel demand from commodity price and new-construction cyclicality.

Several pure-play property-maintenance dispatch tools such as Property Meld appear private; public-market proxies require using APPF, FTDR, or distributors unless a public micro-cap is identified later.

node: Housing repair, rental operations, property services, title/escrow, warranty, and dispatch rails
summary: Expanded the housing-services node through an underfollowed lens. The strongest fit is not homebuilders or mortgage lenders, but companies embedded in repair dispatch, rental-property operating systems, title/escrow transaction rails, and repair/remodel distribution. Four candidates were kept: two mid-cap platform/rail names, one title/escrow transaction name, and one small-cap distributor that is more cyclical but closer to repair/remodel supply flow. No recommendation is implied.
